name: nonprofits
install:
set -euo pipefail
NODE_VERSION=24.21.0
NODE_SHA256=fd8e59d5a511510f6a298afb548f18c7d2b1be404d8b4a27d94fbe49f56cb2d6
PNPM_VERSION=12.4.2
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then as_root() { "$@"; }; else as_root() { sudo "$@"; }; fi
if ! /usr/local/bin/node --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "v${NODE_VERSION}"; then
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz" -o "$tmp"
  echo "${NODE_SHA256}  ${tmp}" | sha256sum -c -
  as_root tar -xJf "$tmp" -C /usr/local --strip-components=1
  rm -f "$tmp"
fi
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
hash -r
export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
as_root corepack enable
corepack prepare "pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION}" --activate
node --version | grep -qx "v${NODE_VERSION}"
pnpm --version | grep -qx "${PNPM_VERSION}"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salasjustin/kru-cursor/main/scripts/cloud-skills.sh | bash -s -- || true
